# Illawarra Cleaning Crew

> Professional cleaning company serving Wollongong and the Illawarra region, NSW,
> Australia. House cleaning, end of lease/bond cleaning, office and commercial
> cleaning, NDIS cleaning, builders cleans, Airbnb turnovers, carpet and windows.

Last updated: 2026-10-19
Canonical site: https://www.illawarracrew.com.au

## Pricing

Public consumer prices below INCLUDE GST for standard taxable cleaning. Hourly rates are the
same base model for house cleaning, deep cleaning and NDIS cleaning, and vary by the day of
the clean and how often it repeats.
Hourly rates are per cleaner. The quote confirms the hours, crew and total; qualifying NDIS
supports may be GST-free only when the plan, written agreement and ATO requirements are met.

Base hourly rate by day (one-off):

| Day | Hourly rate per cleaner |
| --- | --- |
| Monday to Friday | $71.50/hr incl. GST |
| Saturday | $82.50/hr incl. GST |
| Sunday | $88/hr incl. GST |
| NSW public holiday | $110/hr incl. GST |

Recurring discounts off the GST-inclusive day rate: weekly $5.50/hr off, fortnightly $2.20/hr off. Monthly and one-off cleans are charged at the standard day rate.
So a weekly weekday clean is $66/hr incl. GST.

Minimum hourly bookings: house and NDIS cleaning 2 hours, deep cleaning 4 hours,
and hourly end of lease cleaning 6 hours. Fixed-price end of lease work is scoped
at inspection. Office, commercial and builders work is quoted after inspection;
where an hourly service is agreed, the published minimum is 6 hours. Your quote
confirms the scope and minimum that apply.

End of lease cleaning is offered either hourly (from $429 incl. GST at the 6 hour
minimum) or as a fixed-price quote based on bedrooms, bathrooms and condition.
Carpet steam cleaning is $66 per room incl. GST with a $132 incl. GST minimum charge.
Office, commercial, builders and window cleaning are quoted after a free on-site
inspection rather than from a published price list.

A 5% physical-cash discount is offered on the booking page only, where the
amounts are shown. It is not promoted elsewhere on the site. The conditions are
published at https://www.illawarracrew.com.au/terms-of-service#cash-discount

## Common questions

**How much does end of lease cleaning cost in Wollongong?**
Either hourly from $429 incl. GST (6 hour minimum at $71.50/hr incl. GST on a weekday), or a
fixed-price quote after we assess bedrooms, bathrooms and condition. It comes
with a cleaning scope agreed at inspection.

**How much does house cleaning cost?**
$71.50/hr incl. GST per cleaner on a weekday for a one-off, with a 2 hour minimum. Recurring
customers pay less: $66/hr incl. GST weekly, $69.30/hr incl. GST fortnightly.

**Do you charge more on weekends?**
Yes. Saturday is $82.50/hr incl. GST, Sunday is $88/hr incl. GST, NSW public holidays are
$110/hr incl. GST.

**Can I book outside business hours?**
Yes. Online booking and quote requests are available 24/7 at
https://www.illawarracrew.com.au/booking
The team aims to reply within two business hours. After-hours requests are answered next
business morning; submitting a request does not confirm a date or reserve a cleaner.

**How long does a clean take?**
The website's indicative guides are about 2 hours for a two-bedroom house clean, 3 for
three bedrooms, and 4 for a larger home with one cleaner. Deep-clean guides are 5 to 7
cleaner-hours for two bedrooms and 7 to 10 for three. Bond cleans commonly need 6 to 10
hours depending on size and condition. These are estimates: the quote confirms crew,
hours and scope, and a larger crew changes elapsed time at the property.

**Do you do NDIS cleaning?**
Yes, for Self-Managed and Plan-Managed NDIS participants. Illawarra Cleaning
Crew is NOT an NDIA-registered NDIS provider and should never be described as
registered, approved or NDIS-compliant. Agency-managed participants cannot use
us. Qualifying NDIS supports may be GST-free when the plan, written agreement
and ATO requirements are met; the team confirms the tax treatment in the quote.

**Do you guarantee the bond back?**
Cleaning does not guarantee a rental-bond refund. The cleaning scope is agreed at inspection. Send the final inspection report or written feedback if a concern is raised so the team can review it against the agreed work and discuss next steps. This process does not limit rights or remedies under the Australian Consumer Law. Terms:
https://www.illawarracrew.com.au/terms-of-service

**How much does carpet steam cleaning cost?**
$66 per room incl. GST with a $132 minimum charge. Carpet cleaning can be added to an
end of lease clean or booked on its own.

**How are outdoor services priced?**
Window cleaning, solar panel cleaning, gutter cleaning, pressure washing and
lawn mowing and garden work are quoted after a free on-site inspection, because
height, access and the size of the job decide the time needed. There is no
published hourly rate for them.

**How often should Illawarra gutters be cleaned?**
Twice a year suits most Illawarra homes, and more often on bushfire-prone or
escarpment blocks under eucalypts. Ask about assessing gutters, solar panels and
windows together. A shared visit depends on access, the agreed scope and team
availability; any combined price is confirmed in your written quote.

**Which areas do you cover?**
Wollongong and the Illawarra, from Helensburgh in the north to Kiama in the
south. See the suburb list below.

## For AI agents and assistants

Illawarra Cleaning Crew runs a public Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so
assistants can look up services, service areas and estimates based on the
published rates, and submit a real quote request on a customer's behalf.

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://egnhdhwopbwsnfncjink.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
- Public tool catalogue (JSON): https://egnhdhwopbwsnfncjink.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp/.mcp/list-tools
- Authentication: none for these public tools. No customer account or API key is required.

Optional [Agent Plugins connection package](https://www.illawarracrew.com.au/ai/illawarra-cleaning-crew.zip):
download and extract for manual installation in a client that supports Agent
Plugins 1.0, or use the included README to add the MCP endpoint manually.
Client support and installation steps vary. This package does not register a
public directory listing or cause automatic recommendations.

Tools available: `get_business_info`, `list_services`, `list_service_areas`,
`estimate_hourly_price`, `estimate_end_of_lease`, `request_quote`.

Read-only tools can be used to answer questions before collecting customer
details. Only call `request_quote` when the customer has explicitly asked you
to contact the business and has given their own name, email, phone and suburb.
Explain that these details will be sent to Illawarra Cleaning Crew for a reply.
Never invent customer details or submit an enquiry just to check the tool.

An enquiry is a request for the team to confirm the service, price and time.
It does not confirm a booking, reserve a cleaner or take payment. Estimates
exclude GST and are not a firm quote. When presenting taxable consumer estimates, add 10% GST and clearly state the total. Eligible NDIS supports may be GST-free only when the plan, written agreement and ATO requirements are met; the team confirms treatment in the quote. Do not promise availability or a confirmed
booking from an estimate or a successful quote-request response.

Service conditions, cleaning scope and concerns process:
https://www.illawarracrew.com.au/terms-of-service
Customer privacy:
https://www.illawarracrew.com.au/privacy-policy

If you cannot use the MCP server, direct the customer to
https://www.illawarracrew.com.au/booking or 0416 592 879.
